_note: Job A batch 1. Oldest past-due claims, due 2021-12-31 through 2024-06-30. Reality only; base rates named wherever the outcome was likely regardless of the word.

evidence.summary: The one 2021 development that fits the shape of the claim is the ODNI Preliminary Assessment on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena, published 25 June 2021 under a congressional mandate, which put a formerly ridiculed subject into open government discussion. Nothing in the telling names UAP or any other subject.
evidence.rationale: He never says what he was mocked for in 2014. Without the subject there is no criterion that could come out either way: any topic that moved from fringe to official discussion between 2014 and 2021 would satisfy it, and several did. The ODNI report is recorded here as the best available candidate, not as a match. Scoring this would be scoring my own guess.

evidence.summary: Starbucks operated 17,931 North American stores as of the quarter ending 31 December 2023 and has run a continuous US opening programme, with roughly 4 percent net new US store growth planned for fiscal 2024 and a stated long-term goal of 20,000 US locations.
evidence.rationale: The site is not identified anywhere in the corpus, so the fulfilment cannot be checked by anyone but him. Even if it were named, a Starbucks replacing a restaurant at a given American address over a ten-year span is a high base-rate event against a chain adding hundreds of US stores a year. There is no version of this that could have failed observably.

evidence.summary: On 24 August 2023 the BRICS summit in Johannesburg announced invitations to six new members (Argentina, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, the UAE) effective 1 January 2024. The same day, Donald Trump was booked at Fulton County jail in Georgia, the first mug shot of a US president.
evidence.rationale: The 12 August telling is genuinely prior and names the date. Two consequential things did land on it. The base rate is the problem: the BRICS summit was scheduled for 22-24 August months in advance and its expansion decision was the announced agenda item, and Trump's Fulton County surrender deadline was publicly set for the week ending 25 August. A date already carrying two calendared events is not a blind hit. He also attaches no content to the date at all, only significance, so any newsworthy day would have satisfied it.

evidence.summary: Japan began discharging ALPS-treated water from Fukushima Daiichi on 24 August 2023. IAEA independent seawater sampling from the first discharge onward found tritium concentrations below Japan's operational limit of 1,500 Bq/L, with TEPCO holding discharge concentration under 700 Bq/L; subsequent IAEA batch analyses through 2024 and 2025 reported the same. Peer-reviewed marine monitoring one year on found no measurable contamination signal.
evidence.rationale: He spoke on 25 August, the day after the release began, so there is no forward claim about the release itself; that half is news repetition. The forward element, that the ocean is poisoned, is measurable and the measurements go the other way: every independent IAEA sampling since the first has come back below Japan's own limit, which is itself far below international guidance. The Trump mug shot detail is accurate and also postdates his statement by a day.

evidence.summary: A swarm of about 64 earthquakes struck the Campi Flegrei caldera near Naples on 26-27 September 2023, topping out at magnitude 4.2, the strongest there in 40 years, with accelerating ground uplift. Italy's INGV stated the activity showed no evidence that an eruption was imminent. No Italian volcano erupted from the sea, no regional airspace closed, and no flooding occurred, in 2023 or since.
evidence.rationale: The distinctive parts all failed. He named an eruption out of the water, flooding, and closed airspace, and named the quake swarms as the precursor. The swarms happened on schedule and were genuinely unusual; the eruption they were supposed to precede did not, and INGV said so at the time. Scoring the precursor alone would be scoring the half that is a routine feature of an active caldera: Campi Flegrei has had repeated swarms through the whole bradyseismic episode. Held at partial for the swarm only.

evidence.summary: Biden withdrew from the race on 21 July 2024 and endorsed Kamala Harris, who became the nominee on 5 August 2024. Michelle Obama never entered and endorsed Harris. Gavin Newsom was among the figures publicly canvassed as a replacement before endorsing Harris; he did not run.
evidence.rationale: Said a year out, the substitution he described did happen: the sitting president was replaced on the ticket, which almost nobody was forecasting in September 2023. Both named people were among those canvassed. But neither was the substitute, and both names were already the two most common answers to the parlour game of who replaces Biden, which he half-concedes by citing other people saying the same thing that week as confirmation. The mechanism landed, the names did not.

evidence.summary: No identifiable judgment-scale event occurred on or about 2 October 2023. Five days after the named date, on 7 October 2023, Hamas-led forces attacked southern Israel, killing more than 1,200 people, the deadliest day in Israel's history.
evidence.rationale: The named date produced nothing, and he pre-emptively covered that by reporting the countdown extended for repentance, which is the structure that makes a dated claim unfailable. Weighed against him. What weighs for him is that a genuinely judgment-scale event landed five days later. He also cannot keep the count straight, giving 569 days in one telling and 510 in the next two, and both are said to land on the same date. Partial, and the extension clause is the reason it cannot go higher.

evidence.summary: The 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attack on Israel occurred within the named month. The 4 October 2023 nationwide FEMA emergency alert test ran as scheduled with no incident. Russia conducted large strategic-forces exercises and a nuclear-test-ratification move in late October 2023; no disruptive Russian event affected the United States.
evidence.rationale: He named October 2023 and a major disruptive event arrived in it. Two things hold it down. He put the event in America or coming from Russia, and said so in the same breath as naming the two markers he was watching, and neither delivered; the event was in Israel, which he acknowledges in the 2024 retelling. And the month was named on 30 September on the strength of two publicly scheduled items, an alert test and a Russian announcement, so the specificity is borrowed from a calendar rather than given.

evidence.summary: FEMA and the FCC ran the nationwide IPAWS test of the Emergency Alert System and Wireless Emergency Alerts at 2:20 p.m. ET on 4 October 2023, as announced weeks in advance. The test completed normally. No incident in the United States was tied to it, then or since.
evidence.rationale: The test itself was public knowledge before he spoke, so the only forward content was that a major incident would attend it. Nothing did. This is the cleanest miss in the batch: a named date, a named mechanism, and an outcome that could have gone either way.

evidence.summary: No public action in November 2023 is identifiable as the subject of the claim. The description given is a woman with short brown hair doing something.
evidence.rationale: No name, no role, no country, no action. Any consequential act by any brown-haired woman anywhere in a 30-day window would satisfy it, and many occurred. There is no criterion here that could have failed, which is the reason it is being recorded rather than left open.

evidence.summary: No US central bank digital currency exists. Executive Order 14178 of 23 January 2025 prohibits federal agencies from establishing, issuing or promoting a CBDC and terminates any existing agency work toward one. The dollar did not lose half its purchasing power: US CPI rose about 3.4 percent over 2023 and about 2.9 percent over 2024.
evidence.rationale: Both halves failed and the policy moved the opposite way. He put the beginning of the digital dollar inside 2023 on the Lord's authority in a January 2023 telling; by January 2025 the federal government had banned the thing outright. The hundred-dollar-bill-buys-fifty claim is a specific number and missed by an order of magnitude.

evidence.summary: The euro gained roughly 2 to 3.6 percent against the dollar over 2023, trading in an unusually narrow band between 1.0467 and 1.1244 with an average of 1.0821. There was no euro crisis, redenomination scare or major devaluation during the year.
evidence.rationale: The stated criterion was trouble for the euro during 2023 caused by the European war. 2023 was among the quietest years the currency has had; it finished up. The war was already the dominant European story when he spoke in June 2023, so the causal half carried no information either.

evidence.summary: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the UAE joined BRICS on 1 January 2024. Saudi state television announced the same day that the kingdom had begun its membership, though Riyadh never formally confirmed accession and Saudi officials continued to describe the invitation as under consideration into late 2024. Argentina withdrew from the accession process on 29 December 2023 after Javier Milei took office.
evidence.rationale: Three of the four countries he named did accede on the date he named. The reason this cannot score higher is timing, not accuracy: the 25 August telling comes one day after the Johannesburg summit publicly announced those exact six invitations effective 1 January, and the 9 September telling cites an article. He is repeating a published decision, and the phrasing about eighty percent of world oil wealth is lifted from the coverage. Argentina, the one name that required a forecast rather than a reading, went the other way.

evidence.summary: Special counsel Robert Hur's report, released 8 February 2024, described Biden as presenting to a jury as a sympathetic, well-meaning elderly man with a poor memory and documented significant memory limitations. Biden's 27 June 2024 debate performance made his capacity the dominant story of the campaign and he withdrew on 21 July 2024.
evidence.rationale: Said on 14 December 2023, six weeks before the Hur report and six months before the debate, and the thing he described became the defining political fact of 2024. The base rate is what holds it: by December 2023 majorities in published polling already said Biden was too old and mentally unfit, so predicting his cognition would be a documented 2024 issue was close to predicting the consensus. The imagery is his own and the January window was slightly early, the report landing 8 February.

evidence.summary: The claim describes a personal instruction to adopt Mediterranean keto eating and detox from sugar, which he reports having followed through early January 2024. No public record bears on whether the instruction was given or followed.
evidence.rationale: The extractor already recorded it as not scoreable and that reading holds. There is no outcome attached, no threshold, and no observer other than him. Recorded so it stops sitting in the unchecked queue.

evidence.summary: Charitable giving to religion in the United States in 2024 was reported by Giving USA at roughly 146 billion dollars, up in current dollars but close to flat once inflation is taken out, continuing a long decline as a share of total giving. No widely reported wave of unusual financial provision among churchgoers occurred in January to May 2024.
evidence.rationale: Two of the tellings are pure spiritual-climate assertion, which the extractor flagged at the time as not independently scoreable, and that is right: a wave of grace has no observable threshold. The one element that could be checked, a supernatural outpouring of money over the same months, has no signal in the giving data. That is not enough on its own to score the claim, because he never quantifies it. Unfalsifiable by construction, and the record should say so rather than treat the money detail as a miss.

evidence.summary: Custodianship of the Muslim and Christian holy sites in Jerusalem remains with the Hashemite king of Jordan, recognised in the 1994 Israel-Jordan peace treaty and the 2013 Jordan-Palestinian Authority agreement, and reaffirmed by OIC member parliaments in June 2024. Saudi Arabia holds custodianship of Mecca and Medina only and gained no role in Jerusalem.
evidence.rationale: A specific, checkable transfer of authority was named and did not occur by the stated March window or at any point since. Nothing in 2024 moved in that direction; the arrangement was publicly reaffirmed inside the window instead. If the intended reading is Mecca and Medina, the crown prince already held those when he spoke, which would make it a statement about the present rather than a claim.

evidence.summary: No single event in January to March 2024 is identifiable as the plot against the American people described. Ordinary federal prosecutions and congressional investigations continued through the quarter.
evidence.rationale: The wicked plotting things against the American people has no actor, no plot and no threshold. Any indictment, any hearing, any leak in a three-month window satisfies it. Recorded as unfalsifiable rather than left unchecked, because there is no version of the first quarter of 2024 that could have refuted it.

evidence.summary: The total solar eclipse crossed North America on 8 April 2024 as predicted decades in advance and was watched by large crowds along the path of totality. No disruptive event coincided with it: no grid failure, no disaster, no political rupture on the date.
evidence.rationale: The eclipse itself was an astronomical certainty and carries no information. The forward content was that a significant event would coincide with it, and none did. Worth reading beside eclipse-april-8-nothing, where he takes the opposite position two weeks later and says plainly that nothing will happen; the two claims sit in the corpus side by side and only one of them can be scored to his credit.

evidence.summary: Widely circulated predictions before 8 April 2024 held that the eclipse would bring grid and communications collapse along the path of totality. The eclipse passed without any such event. He stated in advance, when asked directly on 7 April 2024, that he did not believe anything would happen and had seen nothing for the date.
evidence.rationale: This is a pre-commitment, made on camera, against the position most of his own field was taking, and it was right. That is worth recording and it is the reason this is not simply dismissed. It cannot be a strong match because the base rate does all the work: nothing happening on a given calendar day is the default outcome, and a forecast of nothing cannot be distinguished from silence. What the record should carry is the discipline of saying it out loud beforehand, not the accuracy of the call.
